name: anonymized-boundary-source-comparison
provenance: Complete set of anonymized reusable conclusions explicitly listed for the validated area-calculation case in product specification Issue #1. The raw conversation remains project evidence and is intentionally excluded from Git because it can contain real project data.
applicability: Use as reasoning guidance when walls, floors, roofs or existing boundaries disagree about an Area footprint.
observations: A roof-level structural floor can be stronger evidence for the covered footprint than the floor element hosted on the target level.
Uncovered corridors, balconies and similar special regions require a project-specific confirmation instead of a fixed universal factor.
Screenshot observations must be checked against structured geometry before they influence an Area boundary proposal.
When evidence conflicts, present a small set of alternatives with the expected consequence of each choice.
